preview.//: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL/WEB_URL below are PLACEHOLDERS, not confirmed real hosts — see mobile/CLAUDE.md and docs/GAPS.md #35. They use the .invalid TLD (RFC 2606: reserved, guaranteed never to resolve) so src/api/client.ts and src/config.ts can refuse an unreplaced value outright instead of a build silently shipping a hostname nobody deployed. Replace both with the real Railway/Vercel staging hosts once they exist.

production.//: See the `preview` profile's `//` comment above — same placeholder situation for the production hosts.

ios.//: ascAppId, appleTeamId and appleId come from the Apple Developer account. `eas submit` will prompt for them and can write them back here; they are not secrets. See mobile/CLAUDE.md.

android.//: serviceAccountKeyPath points at a Google Play service-account JSON. Keep the file OUT of the repo (it is a credential) and set the path locally, or upload it to EAS with `eas credentials`.
